judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` with field `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` with field `conversations`). It omits the required `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code entirely, instead enabling the feature unconditionally and returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is absent—directly violating the acceptance criterion that no code path sends an empty list when unsupported. Its validator also allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` rather than enforcing `1-200`, and it logs `error.message` on store failure, which the spec forbids to avoid leaking store details/credentials. Finally, it misses the required updates to `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`.
